transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess they brought me in because of what happened at the fair. I was giving my talk, and... I just climbed up onto the tractor. I kept jerking the controls around. I was trying to show the crowd this... new pattern. And, well, I couldn't stop. Even with folks yelling at me to get down. So... here I am.
In the weeks leading up to this incident, had you been feeling unusually energetic, needing less sleep than usual, or feeling like your thoughts were racing?

Well... I suppose sleep hasn't been much of a priority lately. Most nights I just... I might catch two or three hours in my chair. Or maybe none at all. But I'm always up before the sun. Feel completely charged, really. Ready to work the place like... like nothing happened. I don't know about racing thoughts, though. Just... busy.
When you were on the tractor, did you believe that you were actually receiving messages or special instructions from someone or something else?

Messages? I... I don't know if I'd use that word. Just... warnings. 

My wife, she keeps bringing out the lender's paperwork. Shows it to me, says it's just plain numbers. But she's not really looking at the yield maps. Or the drone reports. If you look at them... the numbers are odd. They're coded. 

It's just a warning that folks are trying to take the farm out from under me. That's all it is.
Have you ever had these thoughts about the numbers being coded or warnings from others during times when you were feeling completely normal and not full of energy?

I... yeah, I suppose. There was a spell a while back. A few weeks where things were just... quiet. I wasn't running on empty or feeling all fired up then, just... regular. 

But... the numbers still had those warnings in 'em. And... well, I could still hear the lines out by the county road. Talking. 

I don't really want to get into all that, though.
During that quiet spell you mentioned, when you weren't feeling full of energy, how long did those experiences—the warnings in the numbers and hearing the voices—last for?

I reckon... maybe three or four weeks. Like I said, it was quiet. I wasn't fired up, just... going about my day. But I still heard the lines talking. And the data... well, the warnings were still there. That's all.
During that quiet spell you mentioned, did you experience those voices or the warnings in the data every single day for at least two weeks, even though your mood was stable?

Yeah... I suppose so. Every day. Even when I wasn't feeling all... wound up. Just those few weeks where things were quiet, but... the lines still talked. And the warnings in the data didn't stop. It just... was what it was.
